summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Buscema lead capture app. All 13 pytest cases and both Playwright UI flows passed. Auth, CRUD, filters, semicolon CSV export (no card_photo column), and real Claude Sonnet 4.6 OCR against a generated business card all working. Frontend form saves, resets while preserving fiera, and the History page login/filter/CSV export flow works with the saved lead visible under Priorità A.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes JWT fallback secret 'change-me' - env var is set correctly, but consider raising on missing secret in production.
OCR endpoint /api/leads/ocr is unauthenticated - anyone with URL can burn LLM quota. Consider adding verify_token dep or rate limiting.

list_leads uses regex from user input directly (no re.escape) - not a security issue in Mongo (parameterised), but special regex chars in filter values could produce unexpected matches or ReDoS on large inputs.
server.py mixes routes + models + auth + OCR in a single file (~240 lines) - still under threshold, but plan to split as it grows.
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed leads created via API (TEST_ACME_*, TEST_UNIQ_*, TEST_B_*, TEST_UI_ACME Srl) - all with 'TEST_' prefix for easy cleanup. Not auto-deleted since no delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers auth, CRUD, filters, export (semicolon, no card_photo), and real OCR via emergentintegrations Claude Sonnet 4.6. Frontend tested via Playwright: form + chips + priority + stars + save + reset; History login + priority filter + CSV download. QR camera scan intentionally skipped (headless). OCR is exposed unauthenticated - flag for consideration.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Note: My first read of leads-count right after history login showed 0 due to test timing (read before fetch resolved); actual filter-by-A returned 3 leads including the freshly saved one, confirming end-to-end persistence.
